purpose: Isolated diagnostic; identities and geometry are not fully reviewed for gameplay.

boundary_policy.meaning: Default Natural Earth de facto control is a development baseline, not a sovereignty claim or approval of disputed identities. Preserve alternative views without changing canonical IDs or scoring. Verify Indian and other applicable mapping/distribution requirements before release.

limitations: Code corroboration does not establish geographic correctness.
Egypt was repaired with GEOS make_valid; repair requires geographic review.
No candidate reachability, hit testing, accessibility, performance, or live scoring approval is implied.
Context features are noninteractive and have not been assigned to game identities.
